title: Wheels and a Gyro in a Filter: The Wheels Tell the Gyro Its Bias When They Say the Robot Is Going Straight, and the Gyro Tells the Wheels They Slipped

questions.question: Why are the wheels a good teacher of the gyro's bias when the robot is going straight?
options: Their turn is nothing then and so is their error, so the difference is the bias

questions.question: With the wheels alone the heading ended out by:
With the gyro alone the heading ended out by:
With the filter the heading ended out by:
questions.explanation: The bias is learnt when the wheels say straight.

questions.question: What happens to a difference that is far from the estimate?
options: It is refused as a slip
questions.explanation: The wheels were wrong, not the gyro.

questions.question: Why is the filter's variance for a measurement larger when the wheels are turning?
options: The wheels are wrong by a share of their turn rate, so a faster turn is a less certain measurement
questions.explanation: Variance includes (share times turn rate) squared.
